Initial release of plan-architect.

- Converts design documents into executable, highly granular implementation plans (2–5 min/task).
- Features design document parsing, task breakdown, TDD-driven planning, YAGNI & DRY principle enforcement, and output of plan documents with validation checklists.
- Suitable for project implementation, feature development, system refactoring, tech migration, bug-fix planning, and technical debt cleanup.
- Outputs plans in Markdown with detailed steps, dependencies, and time estimates.
- Includes standardized input/output formats, error handling guidelines, and security best practices.
